counts_note: No game data in the box. Viewer forms (33 *Form.cs files) are viewers for user-supplied WZ data, not catalogue content.

looks.label: Particle emitter with variance
looks.technique: Each particle draws position, size, colour, spin and angle from a base value plus random variance; default emission rate 200

looks.label: Segmented tooltip frame
looks.technique: Frame built from corner and edge pieces (nw, ne and others) placed by offset

looks.label: Runtime damage-number style packs
looks.technique: A named style pack chosen from a list at runtime; loads its own number images

originals.name: Segmented Panel Frame
originals.idea: A UI panel built from separate corner and edge pieces so any ornament fits.

originals.name: Drifting Motes
originals.idea: Ambient motes with colour and size variance that fall slowly.
originals.keep: Colour and size variance, slow fall.
originals.change: Motion curve and colours per zone.

originals.name: Skinnable Hit Numbers
originals.idea: Floating damage numbers with named style packs swapped at runtime.
originals.change: Typography and crit and miss shapes.

originals.name: Per-Family Asset Viewer
originals.idea: One small viewer per content family for our asset browser.
